title: GRAPHITE MENUS: THE NEW COLOURS
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): the menus and text still look bad, make it look like a triple-A game; and #20: gritty and grounded, like ARC Raiders. First step of the UI redesign (ui2). Every window was painted in a 16-bit role-playing palette: royal navy with light periwinkle double frames. The whole game now takes one palette: near-black graphite surfaces, thin grey frames, one signal-amber accent, a cream card colour, and clear rarity colours (grey, green, blue, purple, orange). The old colour names are pointed at the new ones, so every window changes at once, and 70 lines of the stylesheet that named the navy and periwinkle directly were moved to the matching graphite. The HUD reads its colours (text, danger red, extraction, teammates) from the same table, so the raid screen and the menus can never drift apart. Nothing about play changes.
now: Every menu now uses the new graphite palette with one amber accent instead of the old navy and periwinkle.
